这一个月来，几乎所有的记名弟子，都认识了王林，一个个看到他时都露出高高在上的表情，语言恶毒的讽刺。
王林对此都是无视，他知道这些记名弟子一个个心里都扭曲变态，他没来时这些人处于门派的最底层，身上承受的苦累无法发泄，现在他来了，靠自杀进入门派的他身份无疑比记名弟子还要低下，所以成为了人人可以欺负的对象。
他心中冷笑，知道这种事情不是反抗可以解决的，门派内强者为尊，那些比他早入门的记名弟子一个个身体都很强壮，更有的甚至还学到一些简单的仙法，他若是反抗，吃亏的一定是他。
不过王林也不是那种软柿子性格，他把所有讥讽的嘴脸都记在心中，等待实力增强后一一回报。
带着这样的想法，他就如同聋子瞎子一般，不管别人如何说，依然我行我素，每日除了挑水就是偷偷研究神秘珠子。
他尝试用各种液体来浸泡珠子，泉水，露水，汗水，甚至连血液都用上，最后发现这些中还是露水效果最佳。
不过露水也有区分，清晨出现在石珠上的露水效果最好，夜晚露水次之，若是从其他物体上采集露水浸泡珠子，效果更差。
以此类推则是泉水，最没有效果的是血液与汗水，几乎半点功效都没有。
为了不惹人注意，他特地在山中找到几个野生的小葫芦，把里面的籽都掏光后，分别用来装不同的露水。
这些葫芦他没带在身上，而是找到一处偏僻地，分不同的位置深深埋在地下，除了每日采集时拿出外，从不拿回门派。
随身携带的，是装着泉水的葫芦，疲惫时喝上几口，立刻精神焕发。
除此之外，王林也发现了一个奇怪的现象，那就是每当夜晚或者清晨石珠上浮现露水时，往往珠子表面看似都是水珠，可实际采集时却会有一大半露水莫名其妙的消失，最多也就留下不到十分之一。
对于这个奇怪的现象，王林只能归纳为那些露水被珠子吸收了，虽然这个解释有些荒诞，不过除了这个，王林实在想不出其他的答案。
这一日黄昏，王林把剩下的三缸水倒满，对正在打坐修炼的黄衣青年说道：“刘师兄，我要回家一趟，明日不过来了。”
刘姓青年眼睛一翻，扫了王林一眼，鼻子里“嗯”了一声。
王林也不在意，他从张虎那里了解到，记名弟子每年可以有三次回家探亲的机会，可以随时向一个姓孙的长老申请，并讨要可来去自如，展现门派仙术的仙符。
王林记得他爹寿辰将至，说什么也要回去一趟，于是离开杂务处后，向专门负责记名弟子的长老那里走去。
恒岳派分为五副一正六院，五副分别是金木水火土，各有记名弟子居住。内门弟子与长老，大都住在正院，平时挑水，他也曾远远的注视这里，内心充满羡慕之意，这次来到此地后，仔细打量一番，站在正院门外高声说道：“记名弟子王林，求见孙长老。”
一个身穿白衣的年轻人，晃晃悠悠的从正院走出，看了王林一眼，神情高傲说道：“你就是王林？”

看到对方身穿白衣，王林内心一秉，点了点头。
他现在已经知道，恒岳派所有弟子按照等级划分衣服颜色。记名弟子分为灰衣与黄衣，其中黄衣代表获得修炼仙法资格。内门弟子则是根据各自实力，从高到低，衣服分为紫、黑、白、红四种。
白衣青年嘴角一撇，冷淡的扫了眼王林，转身向院内走去，王林面无表情，踱步跟上。
走在正院内，时间不长，他被带到一处种植了花花草草的园子旁，白衣青年懒洋洋的说道：“孙师叔，有记名弟子来找你。”
说完，他漫不经心的站在一旁。
一个苍老的声音，从园子里传来：“你下去吧，记名弟子进来。”
白衣青年轻笑一声，告退。
王林内心很紧张，推开园子门，刚一走进，顿时一股浓郁的药香扑面而来，王林一怔，回头看了看园门，心里纳闷只不过一门之隔，为什么在外面却一点药香都没闻到。
“呆在那里干什么，还不报出名字？”声音露出不满，从园子一角的房间中传来。
王林连忙恭敬道：“弟子王林，拜见孙长老，我爹明天寿辰，弟子想回家一趟。”
“你叫王林？原来就是你，哼，修仙之人讲究斩断凡尘，你这般牵挂俗世，一生都不要想踏入仙门！”苍老的声音训斥道。

Over the past month, almost all the registered disciples have gotten to know Wang Lin. When they saw him, they all showed condescending expressions and made vicious sarcastic remarks.
Wang Lin ignored all this. He knew that each of these registered disciples was twisted and perverted. When he didn't come, these people were at the bottom of the sect and could not vent the hardships they suffered. Now that he is here, his status as a registered disciple is undoubtedly lower than that of the registered disciples, so he has become a target for everyone to bully.
He sneered in his heart, knowing that this kind of thing cannot be solved by resistance. Within the sect, the strong are respected. Those named disciples who started earlier than him are all very strong, and some even learned some simple magic. If he resists, he will definitely suffer the loss.
However, Wang Lin is not the kind of soft-spoken character. He keeps all the sarcastic remarks in his heart and waits to repay them one by one when his strength increases.
With this idea, he is like a deaf and blind man. No matter what others say, he still goes his own way. Apart from carrying water every day, he secretly studies the mysterious beads.
He tried soaking the beads in various liquids, including spring water, dew, sweat, and even blood, and finally found that dew was the most effective.
However, dew is also differentiated. Dew that appears on stone beads in the early morning has the best effect, followed by dew at night. If dew is collected from other objects and soaked in beads, the effect is even worse.
By analogy, it is spring water. The most ineffective thing is blood and sweat, which has almost no effect at all.
In order not to attract attention, he found several wild small gourds in the mountains, took out all the seeds, and used them to hold different kinds of dew.
He did not take these gourds with him, but found a remote place and buried them deeply in the ground at different locations. He never took them back to the sect except when collecting them every day.
What he carries with him is a gourd filled with spring water. When he is tired, he can take a few sips and instantly feel refreshed.
In addition, Wang Lin also discovered a strange phenomenon, that is, whenever dew appears on stone beads at night or early in the morning, the beads often appear to be full of water drops, but when actually collected, more than half of the dew disappears inexplicably, and at most less than one tenth remains.
Regarding this strange phenomenon, Wang Lin could only conclude that the dew was absorbed by the beads. Although this explanation was a bit absurd, Wang Lin really couldn't think of any other answer other than this.
At dusk that day, Wang Lin filled up the remaining three tanks of water and said to the young man in yellow who was meditating: "Brother Liu, I have to go home. I won't be able to come tomorrow."
The young man surnamed Liu rolled his eyes, glanced at Wang Lin, and said "hmm" in his nose.
Wang Lin didn't care either. He learned from Zhang Hu that registered disciples could have the opportunity to go home to visit relatives three times a year. They could apply to an elder named Sun at any time and ask for a magic talisman that would allow them to come and go freely and demonstrate the sect's magic.
Wang Lin remembered that his father's birthday was approaching and he had to go back anyway, so after leaving the miscellaneous affairs office, he walked to the elder who was responsible for registering disciples.
The Hengyue Sect is divided into five branches, one main body and six courtyards. The five branches are metal, wood, water, fire and earth, and each has its own registered disciples. Most of the inner disciples and elders lived in the main courtyard and usually carried water. He had also looked at this place from a distance, filled with envy in his heart. After arriving here this time, he looked at it carefully and stood outside the main courtyard door and said loudly: "Named disciple Wang Lin, please see Elder Sun."
A young man in white swayed out of the main courtyard, glanced at Wang Lin, and said with a proud expression: "Are you Wang Lin?"
Seeing that the other party was wearing white clothes, Wang Lin was heartbroken and nodded.
He now knows that all disciples of the Hengyue Sect divide the color of their clothes according to their rank. named discipleThey are divided into gray clothes and yellow clothes. The yellow clothes represent those who have obtained the qualification to practice immortal magic. For the inner disciples, their clothes are divided into four types: purple, black, white, and red, from high to low, according to their respective strengths.
The young man in white curled his lips, glanced at Wang Lin coldly, turned around and walked towards the courtyard. Wang Lin followed with expressionless steps.
After walking in the main courtyard for a short time, he was taken to a garden planted with flowers and plants. The young man in white said lazily: "Uncle Sun, a registered disciple is here to see you."
After speaking, he stood aside casually.
An old voice came from the garden: "Go down and let the registered disciple come in."
The young man in white clothes smiled and excused himself.
Wang Lin was very nervous. He pushed open the garden door. As soon as he walked in, a strong medicinal fragrance hit his face. Wang Lin was startled and looked back at the garden door. He wondered why he couldn't smell any medicinal fragrance outside despite being only separated by a door.
"What are you doing here, why don't you tell me your name?" The voice showed dissatisfaction and came from the room in the corner of the garden.
Wang Lin hurriedly said respectfully: "Disciple Wang Lin, meet Elder Sun. My father's birthday is tomorrow, and I would like to go home."
"Your name is Wang Lin? So it's you. Huh, people who cultivate immortality are all about cutting off the mortal world. You are so concerned about the secular world. Don't even think about stepping into the immortal gate in your life!" the old voice scolded.
